reasons.day0_channel: NPX-4299 (rule #59, the project owner 30 Oct 2026): FAT config DISK as hdb holding ios_config.txt (GNS3 way, CVAC); EVE-NG has no boot-time vIOS config - see providers/day0_iso_channels.py FatConfigDiskChannel.
reasons.emulator:
cpu_model host + qemu_arch x86_64 (2026-09-10, NPX-460): this entry had never
gotten the same fix its switch sibling "viosl2" got on 2026-08-20 for the
identical documented crash (netplex rule #33) - EVE-NG's own vios.yml pins
`qemu_arch: x86_64`, `-cpu host`, same as viosl2.yml. See viosl2's own comment
a few entries below for the exact live crash signature (memory-pool
corruption -> CPU exception vector 4) this class of mismatch produces.
reasons.qemu_version_default: rule #59 (2026-09-21, NPX-1266): Reverted to EVE-NG's pin (2.4.0). The old 2.12.0 was only a fallback from before QEMU 2.4.0 could be built (NPX-457/NPX-1139, built+lane-verified 2026-09-16); that reason no longer exists.
reasons.boot_timeout_sec:
boot_timeout_sec 240 -> 400 (2026-09-11, Wave 21 U7 + NPX-1031/1032 live
retest): this entry's own comment at the top says "identical underlying
software" to "iosv" above, which already carries 400s - the 240s here was
an inconsistency, not a deliberately-measured-lower value. Live-reproduced
on this exact image (vios-adventerprisek9-m-SPA.157-3.M3/159-3.M4, node-manager
req af4aafa0/deda8b50): the initial-config-dialog genuinely needed more than
one apply_config_serial retry cycle to clear (each cycle costs 30-90s of real
wall clock: boot-banner read + _dismiss_setup_dialog's own poll + the send/
read round trip) - `_retry_deadline_s`'s floor (max(180, boot_timeout-80))
only gave this device 180s (240-80=160, below the 180 floor), enough for
roughly 2 real attempts, not enough for the dialog to reliably clear. 400s
matches iosv's own already-evidenced value and gives max(180, 320)=320s.
